categories.name: Admission to Non-Critical Ward
categories.description: Admission of the patient to a non-critical inpatient ward (Admission NC).
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative Admission NC (id=15) under the OR decomposition of goal id=5. It is observed in variants such as V0008, where patients transition from ER sepsis care to a non-critical inpatient ward.

categories.name: Admission to Intensive Care
categories.description: Admission of the patient to an intensive care inpatient ward (Admission IC). This pathway incurs a negative contribution (-25) to minimizing time-to-treatment softgoals due to its intensive nature.
categories.rationale: Maps 1:1 to declared alternative Admission IC (id=16) under the OR decomposition of goal id=5. The narrative sample confirms its usage in variants like V0605 and V0317 where severe cases require intensive care resources.
